visual_review.visible_evidence: In the early target frames (target_0 to target_7, timestamps 241.43s to 244.43s), the operator is manipulating small components on the gearbox body, consistent with installing the locking lever assembly. The anti-vibration handle is visible in the red tray and is not being touched. In the later target frames (target_8 to target_15, timestamps 328.17s to 331.17s), the operator is holding the anti-vibration handle and screwing it onto the gearbox. This sequence shows the locking lever assembly work occurring before the anti-vibration handle installation.
limitations: The specific start of the locking lever assembly installation is inferred from the manipulation of small parts in the early frames, as the exact moment of the first screw insertion is not explicitly isolated in a single frame, but the activity is clearly distinct from the handle installation seen later.
